decisions.reason: This net price display plugin remains very close to our shop-extension knowledge base, so with in-house R&D and a growing business we would normally retain and incrementally improve it unless it proves too niche.
The ERP interface plugin builds directly on our strongest integration capabilities and supports the firm's multichannel direction, making withdrawal unlikely.
A price comparison tracking plugin fits our analytics and optimization competences well, but overlap with similar tracking products keeps the risk of later portfolio consolidation meaningful.

Because we already rationalized one similar tracking plugin and still have overlap in this area, management would now reallocate resources from this weaker duplicate to the core business and new development.
The net price reporting plugin is adjacent to our existing shop, analytics and extension work, so we can continue to support it effectively and would usually keep it unless demand stays modest.
